韩国与 28 个国家/地区签订打工度假协议、另与英国签订青年交流（YMS）协议，: Korea has working holiday agreements with 28 countries and regions plus a youth mobility scheme (YMS) with the UK, letting people aged 18-30 stay up to 12 months and work no more than 25 hours a week to top up travel funds. The age ceiling varies by nationality (Taiwan 18-34, Hong Kong 18-30). ⚠️ Mainland China is not on the official partner list, so mainland Chinese passport holders cannot apply.
官方不设学历层级门槛。2026-2027 官方手册只把「Proof of stu: No academic-level threshold. The official 2026-2027 handbook lists only 「Proof of student status or highest academic qualifications」 as application material — to verify who you are, not as a level requirement. The handbook also notes these requirements may differ between embassies, consulates and KVACs, so confirm with the office handling your application before preparing documents.
手册资格条件给出门槛 300 万韩元（原文 `Have sufficient f: The handbook's eligibility list sets the threshold at KRW 3,000,000 (official wording: `Have sufficient funds to support yourself for the initial period of your holiday (KRW 3,000,000 minimum)`); the document page asks for `Supporting financial documentation (ex: certified copy of a bank statement)`. It sets no issue-date limit, account-holder rule or statement period, and states plainly that 「requirements may vary among respective Embassies/Consulates/KVAC」.
手册材料清单列 `Medical certificate`（健康诊断书）为必备材: The document list requires a `Medical certificate`, but names no tests; which tests apply is set by each embassy, consulate or KVAC. The earlier record's 「HIV, drug and chest X-ray tests」 had no official basis and has been removed.
资格条件写 `Not have criminal record`，材料清单列 `: Eligibility says `Not have criminal record` and the document list asks for a `Criminal record check`. The handbook sets no issue-date window and no notarisation rule; each embassy, consulate or KVAC decides.
官方原文 `Health Insurance which remains val: Official wording: `Health Insurance which remains valid throughout your stay in Korea (Coverage: KRW 40,000,000 minimum)` — cover of at least KRW 40 million. The earlier euro conversion has been removed rather than guessing an exchange rate.
资格条件写 `Not have previously entered Korea: Eligibility says `Not have previously entered Korea on a working holiday visa`. The general rule is once in a lifetime; bilateral agreements create exceptions for Canadian and Japanese citizens, who may take part twice (Canadians up to 24 months each time). Handbook FAQ: `if you have previously been granted a Korean Working Holiday Visa, you cannot apply for another one. However, exceptions apply depending on nationality.`
H-1 没有统一的全球开放窗口，由辖区韩国使领馆/KVAC 各自安排受理时间；手: There is no single global intake window for H-1; each Korean embassy, consulate or KVAC sets its own. The handbook only requires that you apply from inside your home country and hold the visa before arriving in Korea. Hong Kong and Taiwan applicants should confirm the current schedule with the Consulate-General in Hong Kong and the Korean Mission in Taipei respectively.
官方手册与 WHIC 总则页均未公布 H-1 的审理时长，只写须向辖区使领馆/K: Neither the handbook nor the WHIC overview page publishes a processing time for H-1; both direct you to the embassy, consulate or KVAC. The earlier 「about 7 working days」 had no official basis and has been removed. The only official timing constraint is that the visa must be issued before you enter Korea — you cannot apply after landing.
手册材料清单第 1 项 `Visa application form`；表格版本: Handbook document list, item 1: `Visa application form`. Form version and printing instructions are set by each embassy, consulate or KVAC.
手册材料清单列 `Criminal record check`；开具时限与是否需: The handbook's document list asks for a `Criminal record check`; how recently it must be issued, and whether notarisation is needed, is set by each embassy, consulate or KVAC.
手册材料清单列 `Travel plans`；格式与语言要求由各使领馆/KVAC: The handbook's document list asks for `Travel plans`; format and language requirements are set by each embassy, consulate or KVAC.
H-1 不可续签，但在有限情形下可转其他签证类型（手册 FAQ 原文：`Work: H-1 cannot be extended, though in limited circumstances you may switch to another visa type (handbook FAQ: `Working Holiday Visa cannot be extended but you may be eligible to switch to another type of visa in limited circumstances`). US citizens may extend by up to six months, UK citizens by up to a year, and Canadians may take part twice at up to 24 months each; none of these extensions apply to Hong Kong or Taiwan passport holders.
每周最多工作 25 小时（官方原文 `maximum working hours: At most 25 hours of work per week (official wording: `maximum working hours: 25 hours/week`; handbook Q&A: `H-1 (Working Holiday) Visa holders cannot work more than 25 hours per week`). Canadian citizens are exempt and may work up to 40 hours a week, 2,080 hours a year. Caps on time with one employer and on study differ by nationality: Hong Kong six months each, Taiwan no limit on either, Australia six months with one employer and four months of study, Israel three months with one employer. Work must be `as an incidental aspect of their holiday, rather than primary purpose, in order to supplement their travel funds`. Korea's 2026 minimum wage is KRW 10,320 an hour, and foreign workers get the same rate as Korean workers. The earlier 「1,300 hours a year」 was derived by multiplying 25 by 52 rather than stated officially, and has been removed.
